It resolves a conflict between two earlier lanes that used different baselines and different replays: docs/sharp_weighted_follow.md promoted the leader-median follow at 0.5 on the RAW opener card, while docs/follow_vs_tilts.md measured it at -0.751 points against the nine-member card that is played. Surface here: the served nine-member Tuesday card overlay_union_coach_division_arrests_bye_coldvisitor_protection_interim_tank_precip_v3, the card that is actually played (56.070% on this population, reproducing docs/served_card_harness.md to the digit). Baseline column: not following the late-week market at all (the surface's own pick on every game). Population: 799 scored games of 816 archive games 2023-2025 (17 opener pushes dropped), 54 week blocks, all with replayable late-week exposure, 0 quote rows refused by the frozen function's own backdating guard. Follow replay: the SERVED leader-median arm (leader_median_net_move from nfl_ats.sharp_book_movement_features.late_week_follow_frame), each game's cutoff at its own pick deadline min(kickoff, Sunday 16:00 ET). PARITY CHECK: the same function on the promotion lane's frozen quote cache reproduces its S1 counts exactly (523 fires, 223 switches against the raw card); reloading the same rows from data/market/raw gives 522 fires (one game, 2025_04_SEA_ARI, differs by half a point across the two quote sources) and the identical 223 switches. STATED DEVIATION: the served path loads capture_kind=live and the market store holds no live capture before 2026-08-17, so 2023-2025 is reachable only through the intraday_hourly historical backfill; this is the same substitution docs/served_card_harness.md documents, and it makes this evidence about the rule's SHAPE, not a re-grade of a promotion. Fire counts on the scoped population: 522 at 0.5, 228 at 0.75, 228 at 1.0, 116 at 1.5, and 156 for the equal-book arm at 1.0. Week-blocked and season-blocked paired bootstrap, 20,000 samples, seed 20260821, within-week correlation zero by owner mandate; the recorded interval is the week-blocked one. Reused 2023-2025 window, already mined by the served-card harness and precedence lanes; descriptive reused-window measurement with a stated discount, not independent confirmation. Baseline accuracy 54.682%, candidate 55.431%, picks changed 14 of 267.
